title: Why Foamy Urine Is The First Warning Sign That Your Body’s "Filters" A
headings: Your bladder is designed to be a storage tank for neutral, filtered fluid. But when your kidney filters are "leaking," they release urine that is highly acidic and loaded with heavy toxins like creatinine and urea.
When this "toxic cocktail" travels down and hits your bladder, it acts like acid on a sensitive wound. It strips away the bladder’s protective lining, leaving the nerves raw, red, and angr y.
It isn't just a "sensitive bladder." It is "Downstream Inflammation" caused by unfiltered waste.
